children: The US Food and Drug Administration is expected to announce in coming days a move that would speed up authorizations of vapes and tobacco pouches, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The FDA is expected to announce it will revisit a 2021 rule outlining requirements for new tobacco applications, according to the report.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
